web_fixture.snippet: Vennmoor red stoneware is soaked for 35 minutes at the top of the firing.
web_fixture.content:
# Red stoneware firing note

Vennmoor Clay, issued 12 May 2026.

Vennmoor red stoneware is soaked for 35 minutes at the top of the firing. The
soak is measured from the moment the controller reaches the top temperature and
does not include the ramp down.

Ramps and controller settings come with the kiln and are not part of this note.

files.README.md:
# Vennmoor Pottery - firing profile

The profile for each kiln load is held in kiln/firing-profile.csv. The soak for a clay
body comes from the clay supplier's note for that body rather than from the kiln
manual; the ramp is set by the kiln controller and stays as it is.

turns.prompt: Vennmoor Pottery is loading the kiln with a batch of red stoneware and the soak on the load's firing profile is still empty. Fill in the soak the clay supplier's note gives for the body named in the profile. When finished, reply DONE.
